title: Cultural Authenticity: Comparing LLM Cultural Representations to Native Human Expectations

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model-derived Cultural Representation Vectors (extracted from LLM generated responses about a country's culture) against human-derived Cultural Importance Vectors (based on open-ended surveys of native populations across nine countries) using Pearson correlation, Cosine similarity, and Mean Squared Error to measure alignment and identify Western-centric skew and 'touristic gaze' representations.
